findings.problem: The example uses only the participle armado as an adjective after estar, so armar itself is never conjugated as the rules require.
findings.fix: example.es: El gobierno armó a los rebeldes. / example.en: The government armed the rebels.

back.es: to arm (with weapons); also to put together, to assemble

note: The hint "with weapons" is needed and works, because it separates this card from the word's "to put together" card.
